summary: LTP on an equity and Quote on an index: the ltpc packet gives the LTP frame; the index packet gives OHLC from the day candle, the previous close and the change, and nothing an index does not carry.

deviations.reason: The web's Upstox adapter sends data.mode its own way (the subscription mode number, or no key); the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full). Lead rule 2026-11-09: this follows each broker's own web adapter (lane wire's per-broker dialect switch; bk-a sets the entry in phase B).
The web's Upstox frames carry the subscription's broker token (the instrument key); the desktop's do not. Lane wire to decide whether the carrier passes broker tokens.

The web stamps Upstox Quote and Depth frames with the broker's currentTs; the desktop stamps its receipt time (audit P-02, still open: the Upstox decoder should carry FeedResponse.current_ts, receipt time only when it is absent).
The desktop's index frames carry the change since the previous close, as the recorded Zerodha index transcript does; the web's Upstox adapter sends no change.

The web's Upstox LTP payload is the raw LTPC (ltp, ltq, ltt, cp) and the token, with no timestamp or mode; the desktop's LTP frame carries ltp, ltt, timestamp and mode. Lane wire to decide (LTP frame shape).
